description: Minimal two-axis probe of the gemma-4-E4B negative-ΔPPL anomaly observed under the asym-only-no-nsep ablation (method B) in Phases 19-20. Axis 1: reproducibility across a tripled sample size (30 windows) and a fresh WikiText-2 segment. Axis 2: per-side ablation (K-only vs V-only) to point at the mechanism. Budget-capped at ~30 min; no deep investigation beyond these two axes.

SEG1.note: Same prefix Phase 19 and Phase 20 used; enables direct reproducibility comparison.

SEG2.note: Fresh non-overlapping segment. If the effect is text-specific, SEG2 kills it.

methods.B-KV: asymmetric per-channel INT3 NO nsep, applied to BOTH K and V (original (B) variant)
methods.B-K-only: asymmetric per-channel INT3 NO nsep, applied to K only; V left at bf16
methods.B-V-only: asymmetric per-channel INT3 NO nsep, applied to V only; K left at bf16
methods.D-KV: modeq v0.3 default nsep+pchan asymmetric INT3 on both K and V (sanity check)

reproducibility_track.verdict: CONFIRMED (SEG1 consistently -0.32 to -0.44 across four runs; SEG2 weaker at -0.15 but still negative and outside the noise floor)

kv_split_analysis.script_verdict_raw: mixed / inconclusive (because B-V-only -0.0876 on SEG1 was not < -0.1 threshold)
kv_split_analysis.honest_reading: K-DRIVEN on both segments. See the contribution ratios below.

SEG1.note: Sum of K-only + V-only = -0.4353 vs B-KV -0.4007 suggests near-linear composition; K accounts for ~87% of the observed negative delta.

SEG2.note: On SEG2 the K-only delta is essentially the full effect and V-only is slightly POSITIVE -- V-quantization mildly hurts PPL on SEG2 while K-quantization helps. The combined effect is smaller because K and V partially cancel. This STRENGTHENS the K-as-regularizer reading: V contributes zero or mild harm, and all the regularization signal is on the K path.

kv_split_analysis.verdict_honest: 87% of the negative-ΔPPL effect comes from quantizing K on both segments. V-only is small-negative on SEG1 and small-positive on SEG2, averaging to near-zero and clearly distinct from K's consistent ~-0.13 to ~-0.35. The mechanism is attention-logit-level, not value-pathway.

size_vs_baseline_correlation.observation: The improvement is larger on the higher-baseline segment (17.13 -> -2.34%, 13.45 -> -1.10%). This is consistent with 'quantization noise softens an overconfident attention distribution on text-only inputs of a multimodal-trained model': higher baseline PPL means higher token-level surprise, more room for entropy-increasing noise to help. Not a conclusive test, but a useful corroboration.

D_recipe_is_unaffected.note: The v0.3 recommended method (D) produces essentially identical positive ΔPPL on both segments (+0.9459 / +0.9485). The anomaly is confined to the (B) ablation variant. The v0.3 production claim from Phase 14/16/17 is unchanged.

final_interpretation.mechanism_conjecture: K-driven accidental attention-logit entropy regularization on gemma-4-E4B text-only evaluation. Asymmetric per-channel quantization of the Key cache adds structured noise to K; this perturbs the softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d)) distribution by flattening logits on the large side of the [min, max] window (where asym's step size is largest). On a multimodal-trained model evaluated text-only, the base attention distribution is plausibly slightly over-confident (off-distribution), so increased attention entropy pulls PPL marginally below the unquantized baseline. V-cache quantization, being downstream of softmax, only reduces output fidelity and does not regularize the distribution.
why_this_is_appendix_material_not_main_c: 1) Specific to one multimodal model in our 8-model set. Not generalizable.
2) Effect size is 1-3% PPL, not large enough for a deployment recommendation.
3) The same (B) variant catastrophically regresses on 4 of 8 models (see Phase 19). We cannot ship (B) as a method.
4) (D) v0.3 recipe -- the one we DO ship -- does not exhibit this anomaly; it behaves as ordinary small-positive ΔPPL.
5) Causal claim (noise -> entropy -> PPL) is plausible but not yet instrumented. A proper test would measure attention-entropy shift directly, not just PPL. Future work.
final_interpretation.paper_treatment_suggestion: Appendix note titled 'Accidental K-cache entropy regularization on gemma-4-E4B'. 1 paragraph describing the observation (Phase 19-21 chain), the mechanism conjecture, and explicitly NOT recommending (B) for deployment. Point to Phase 19 4/8 catastrophic cases as counter-evidence. 1-2 references for future work (attention entropy as a regularizer; quantization-aware multimodal inference).

verdict_for_v03_release: UNCHANGED. The v0.3 asymmetric INT3 recipe (D) continues to be the universal production-tier recommendation across the 8-model benchmark. Phase 21 confirms the (B) anomaly is real but isolated to one model and one ablation variant; it does not touch the shipped method.
